svg.title: Emergency coordinator — Woman
svg.desc: A fictional woman working as emergency coordinator, wearing a safety vest. Visible work cue: A folded incident map stands beside a broadcasting coordination antenna. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Appearance: a bob haircut, a rounded face.
